title: sync: seed listings 12 Nov (1)

body:
Updates HappyToHelp from v0.4.22 to v0.4.23 in the seed page, generated listings and sync provenance. The fresh 49-seed dry sync proposed only this version update; the final dry sync reports zero changes. Counts remain 49 total, 35 released and 14 coming soon.

Release: https://github.com/just-every/run-happytohelp/releases/tag/v0.4.23 (non-draft/non-prerelease; rer-release.dsse.json asset present, signature not verified). Released CONTRACT.md is unchanged; README/seed metadata drift was reviewed without adding claims. Existing wording, marks, colours, homepage stills, excluded seeds, pricing and clause statuses are preserved.

Validation: npm ci; copy-only and mechanical sync apply; listings generation/check; type-check; lint; brand check; production build; final full dry sync; candidate HappyToHelp screenshots at 1440 and 390, with version/listing assertions at 1440. Fleet identity/trailer, scope and diff checks pass.

Candidate only. Lane retains independent review, publication scan, merge, deployment and live verification.
